sourceCoordinates: Unmodified Waveshare V1.1 STEP, mm. PCB component top z=0; USB faces +Y.

pcb.notes: The STEP PCB has only small plated/pin holes, no screw-sized mounting holes. Use an enclosure cradle/clamp.

usb.notes: Computed from the planar front rim face and exact vertices. Do not use full connector bbox midpoint: below-board tabs bias it downward. The narrow split at rim bottom is an intentional shell feature.

fpc.notes: Outlet direction inferred from component layout. The exact cable-contact plane and neutral-axis height remain provisional. STEP highest feature is likely actuator-open geometry; do not assume closed height from bbox. Minimum bend radius not sourced.

normalization.description: Optional board-centered XY frame; keep PCB component topz0. Mouth center normalized[-.00996087,8.98172286,1.669522]. Apply rotation/translation only after this, matching assembly rear-wall normal.

precision: Nominal CAD values, not manufacturing tolerances. FPC exitPointProvisional explicitly inferred.
